segments.name: Blank check company
segments.description: Blank check company seeking an initial business combination with businesses in technology, real assets and energy.
segments.evidence: The CODM assesses performance for the single segment and decides how to allocate resources based on net income or loss that also is reported on the statement of operations as net income or loss.

revenueModel.text: It earns no operating revenue from customers; it will not until it completes an initial business combination.
revenueModel.evidence: We have generated no operating revenues to date and we do not expect that we will generate operating revenues until we consummate our initial business combination.
